note: The committed hashes above are immutable and unchanged. This addendum only closes two protocol rules that earlier wording left ambiguous, per external audit review of 17 Aug 2026.

cumulative_sampling_rule.universe: deduplicated union of commitment hashes across ALL chained batches of this generation published before the announced cutoff
cumulative_sampling_rule.selection: exactly K = min(100, N_total) smallest scores, hex ascending
cumulative_sampling_rule.cumulative_manifest: published before the beacon: every batch file, its SHA-256, per-batch and total counts, and the SHA-256 of the sorted union

outcome_commitment_rule.tree: leaves sorted ascending; parent = sha256(left|right); odd level: last node promoted unchanged
order: 1: season closes; outcomes computed for the FULL population
2: Merkle root of all outcome leaves published on the verification page
3: only then the public beacon is read
4: each sampled entry is revealed with payload, verdict salt, outcome_class, evidence_hash, outcome salt and its Merkle inclusion proof

beacon: first Bitcoin block with timestamp >= 2027-07-01T00:00:00Z that remains canonical at depth 144
